title: The  race to build AGI: who's winning in 2026?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The race is already won—AGI is here, and it's built on open protocols like the Transformer architecture. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: You're wrong. The race is just beginning—China's state-backed labs and private firms are accelerating with quantum-enhanced neural nets. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Open-source frameworks like DeepMind’s Chameleon and Meta’s Llama 3 are democratizing AGI, not slowing it down. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But real progress is in proprietary systems—Google’s Gemini and Alibaba’s Tongyi are ahead in multilingual reasoning and real-time learning. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The race is wide open—AGI isn’t a single finish line, it’s a global sprint. (4 sec)
